examples.claim: Only 20.4%-38.2% of KV cache memory holds actual token states in existing systems; blog says 60-80% wasted
examples.source: paper §1: 'only 20.4% - 38.2% of the KV cache memory is used to store the actual token states in the existing systems'; blog: 'existing systems waste 60% – 80% of memory'

examples.claim: Only two blocks reserved for the 7-token prompt; physical blocks 7, 1, 3 map to logical 0, 1, 2
examples.source: paper §4.3: 'vLLM maps the first 2 logical KV blocks (0 and 1) to 2 physical KV blocks (7 and 1, respectively)'; 'allocates a new physical block (physical block 3)'

examples.claim: vLLM blog reports near-optimal memory use with under 4% waste
examples.source: blog: 'near-optimal memory usage, with a mere waste of under 4%'

examples.claim: CacheConfig.block_size: tokens per contiguous block, must be > 0, declared default None, always int after construction
examples.source: cache.py: 'block_size: int = Field(default=None, gt=0)'; 'Accepts None (meaning "use default"). After construction, always int.'

examples.claim: Beam search k=4 table: afterwards all share 0,1,3; 0-1 share 6; 2-3 share 7; blocks 2,4,5,8 freed; 9-12 allocated
examples.source: paper §4.4: 'vLLM frees all physical blocks whose reference counts reach 0 (blocks 2, 4, 5, 8) ... allocates new physical blocks (blocks 9-12) ... all candidates share blocks 0, 1, 3; candidates 0 and 1 share block 6, and candidates 2 and 3 further share block 7'

examples.claim: On memory exhaustion the scheduler preempts the latest request's whole sequence group; blocks are swapped to CPU or recomputed
examples.source: paper §4.5: 'the latest requests are preempted first'; 'all-or-nothing eviction policy'; 'gang-scheduled as a sequence group'; 'we consider two techniques: Swapping ... Recomputation'

examples.claim: SchedulerConfig.policy default 'fcfs'; 'priority' handles lower values first
examples.source: scheduler.py: 'policy: SchedulerPolicy = "fcfs"'; '"priority" means requests are handled based on given priority (lower value means earlier handling)'

examples.claim: v0.8.1 V1 status: Optimized prefix caching/chunked prefill; Functional LoRA/multimodal; WIP spec decode; Planned FP8 KV cache, embedding, Mamba, encoder-decoder
examples.source: v0.8.1 v1_user_guide.md feature table rows match; note the guide has a fifth state (Deprecated) that the post's '네 단계' (L230) omits from the table

examples.claim: RFC #2614: every block identified by hash(prefix tokens, tokens in this block); hash table inserted between logical and physical block tables; all sharing via one mechanism
examples.source: issue #2614: 'every block in the KV cache can be uniquely identified by hash(prefix tokens, tokens in this block)'; 'Logical block table --> hash table --> physical block table'; 'all the sharing in vLLM, including sharing prefixes, can be achieved by logical blocks pointing to the block with the same hash value'

examples.claim: Spheron: on shortage vLLM evicts the LRU block at the head of the free queue
examples.source: Spheron: 'vLLM evicts using LRU, dropping the least-recently-used head block from its free queue and removing its hash table entry'
